cases.name: read-version-characters-leading-hyphen
cases.note: An Install whose Package.Version starts with '-' is unreadable under the default rule. Control: read-version-characters-allowed.

cases.name: read-version-characters-slash
cases.note: '/' is not a character the default rule allows in Package.Version. Control: read-version-characters-allowed.

cases.name: read-version-characters-update
cases.note: The default version character rule applies to an Update. Control: read-version-characters-allowed.

cases.name: read-version-characters-uninstall
cases.note: The default version character rule names Install and Update only.

cases.name: read-version-characters-allowed
cases.note: ASCII letters, digits, '.', '-', '+' and '_' are allowed; the version is concrete.

cases.name: read-version-characters-tilde-winget
cases.note: '~' is a character only some readings add, not WinGet's. Control: read-version-characters-tilde-npm.

cases.name: read-version-characters-tilde-npm
cases.note: Npm adds '~' to the version characters; '~1.2.3' is not a Semantic Versioning 2.0.0 version, so Npm reads it as a range and the version is missing.

cases.name: read-version-characters-equals-cargo
cases.note: Cargo adds '='; '=1.2.3' is not a version, so Cargo resolves it as a range and the version is missing.

cases.name: read-version-characters-equals-npm
cases.note: '=' is a Cargo addition, not Npm's. Control: read-version-characters-equals-cargo.

cases.name: read-version-characters-range-dotnet
cases.note: Dotnet adds '[', ']', '(', ')' and ','; the range is not a version, so the version is missing.

cases.name: read-version-characters-range-powershell7
cases.note: PowerShell7 adds '[', ']', ',' and spaces; the range is not a version, so PowerShell7 resolves it as a range and the version is missing.

cases.name: read-version-characters-range-powershell
cases.note: PowerShell adds no version characters, so '[' makes the request unreadable. Control: read-version-characters-range-powershell7.
